data.description: Jumeirah Golf Estates: Where Luxury Living Meets World-Class Golfing.

data.answer:
Jumeirah Golf Estates is one of the most eco-friendly areas in Dubai, set within a beautifully landscaped environment. Residents enjoy world-class amenities, including two championship golf courses, a state-of-the-art clubhouse, fitness centers, swimming pools, tennis courts, and dining options.

It is one of the freehold areas in Dubai, designed for those who value relaxation and an active lifestyle, with plenty of opportunities for socializing and recreation. Families benefit from proximity to top-tier schools and healthcare facilities, while professionals appreciate the convenient access to Dubai's business districts. The serene surroundings, coupled with the vibrant community spirit, make Jumeirah Golf Estates a perfect blend of elegance and comfort.

Jumeirah Golf Estates comprises 16 unique communities overlooking the Earth Course and Fire Course. Inspired by Mediterranean architecture, the Earth Course features 606 Jumeirah Golf Estates villas spread across six developments. The Fire Course, designed with a desert theme and colors, includes 438 residences across seven developments—the villas in this gated community range from 3 to 6 bedrooms, each with a private garden.

The community also offers 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and 2 to 4-bedroom townhouses, providing a variety of living options to suit different needs and preferences.

Off-Plan Projects in Jumeirah Golf Estates

Many projects are under development in the area. Here is a list of off-plan properties at Jumeirah Golf Estates.

Signature Mansions
Signature Mansions is a complex of 18 standalone villas offering breathtaking views of the golf estate. The villas in Signature Mansions comprise 4 or 5 bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms.

Terra Golf Collection
You can find 6-bedroom standalone and twin villas, along with 6-bedroom townhouses in Terra Golf Collection. The Jumeirah Golf Estates villa location is ideal, boasting a gym, cinema, Jacuzzi, and many other amenities.

Royal Golf Villas Jumeirah Golf Estates
Another property in Jumeirah Golf Estates, Royal Golf Boutique Villas, offers houses in different layouts, ranging from villas to townhouses. These Jumeirah Golf Estates villas are a project by DAMAC Properties that offers serene community views.

Jasmine Lane
Jasmine Lane by Elie Saab boasts elegant 3-bedroom houses. It is close to a world-class golf destination, offering residents an unmatched lifestyle.

Al Andalus
The apartment clusters in Al Andalus consist of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments. Spread over 6 hectares, Al Andalus features 5 km of walking pathways and landscaped gardens.

Renting a Property in Jumeirah Golf Estates Dubai

Are you searching for properties for rent in Jumeirah Golf Estates? You can find 1-bedroom Jumeirah Golf Estates apartments for rent for AED 84k, while 2-bedroom units can be rented out for AED 120k per year. The minimum rent for 3-bedroom apartments in the area is AED 170k.

If you want more spacious accommodations, townhouses in the area are a good choice. The rental price of 3-bedroom townhouses starts at AED 120k, whereas 4-bedroom units are available for AED 395k per annum.

There are also many villas in the community to choose from. If you are interested in a 4-bedroom Jumeirah Golf Estates villa, the rental price will be around AED 395k; meanwhile, for a 5-bedroom villa, you need to pay AED 550k minimum.

Buying a Property in Jumeirah Golf Estates

You can find various properties for sale at Jumeirah Golf Estates. The cozy 1-bedroom apartments for sale in Jumeirah Golf Estates cost at least AED 925k, while 2-bedroom units are available for a minimum of AED 2.5M. If you are looking for a larger apartment, the one with 3 bedrooms will suit you, available at the starting price of AED 2.25M.

The 3-bedroom townhouses in Jumeirah Golf Estates are available for AED 3.99M, whereas 4-bedroom units are available for AED 5.8M. If you are interested in villas, many Jumeirah Golf Estate Villas for Sale are also available in the category. 4-bedroom houses for sale in Jumeirah Golf Estates will cost about AED 6.2M, and a 5-bedroom house will be available for AED 7.78 M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Jumeirah Golf Estates?

data.answer:
Life in Jumeirah Golf Estates is a blend of luxury, tranquility, and community living. Residents enjoy world-class amenities, including two championship golf courses, a country club, sports facilities, and lush green landscapes. The community offers high-end villas, townhouses, and apartments, all designed to the highest standards. With its family-friendly environment, excellent location near major city attractions, and vibrant social scene, Jumeirah Golf Estates provides an exceptional lifestyle that combines comfort, convenience, and exclusivity.

Public Transportation in Jumeirah Golf Estates

The area is well-connected to public transportation in Dubai. The Jumeirah Golf Metro Station, part of Route 2020, serves the community, while the bus stops near the area are Sports City, Victory Heights West Gate Bus Stop (10 minutes away), and Dubai Production City Bus Stop (16 minutes away).

Supermarkets in Jumeirah Golf Estates

In Jumeirah Golf Estates, residents enjoy convenient access to several top-tier supermarkets, ensuring all their grocery needs are met with ease. Geant Hypermarket offers a wide variety of products, from fresh produce to international foods, making it a favorite for those seeking quality and variety.

Spinneys, known for its premium selection, provides a range of organic and specialty items, along with excellent customer service, catering to health-conscious shoppers and gourmet enthusiasts.

Grandiose Supermarket stands out with its focus on fresh, locally sourced produce and a unique assortment of international brands, providing a delightful shopping experience. These supermarkets collectively enhance the lifestyle in Jumeirah Golf Estates, offering diverse and high-quality shopping options.

Shopping Malls Near Jumeirah Golf Estates

Residents of Jumeirah Golf Estates enjoy proximity to several prominent shopping destinations, enhancing their lifestyle with convenience and variety. First Avenue Mall in Motor City, just 18 minutes away, offers a mix of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities, making it a perfect spot for family outings.

Circle Mall in Jumeirah Village Circle, located 19 minutes away, features a range of fashion stores, supermarkets, and casual dining, catering to the everyday needs of the community. The Fairway Mall, another nearby shopping center, provides a selection of essential services, retail shops, and eateries, ensuring residents have easy access to all their shopping and leisure needs.

Schools and Nurseries in Jumeirah Golf Estates

Jumeirah Golf Estates is an ideal community for families, offering access to several esteemed schools and nurseries. The nearby Victory Heights Primary School is known for its excellent academic programs and extracurricular activities, while the Wonder Years Nursery offers a warm, stimulating environment for early childhood development.

Additionally, the nearby Jumeirah English Speaking School (JESS) in Arabian Ranches is renowned for its strong academic curriculum and supportive learning environment. These educational facilities ensure that families in Jumeirah Golf Estates have access to some of the best schooling options in Dubai, fostering a supportive and enriching environment for children's growth and learning.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Jumeirah Golf Estates

Jumeirah Golf Estates is a diverse and inclusive community that provides access to various places of worship for residents of different faiths. Within the community and nearby areas, there are several mosques, including the Jumeirah Golf Estates Mosque, which serves as a spiritual center for the Muslim community.

For Christian residents, the St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church in Jebel Ali is just a short drive away, offering a range of services and community activities. Hindu residents can visit the Shiva and Krishna temples in Bur Dubai, which are about a 30-minute drive from the community, providing a place for worship and cultural gatherings. These places of worship ensure that residents of Jumeirah Golf Estates can practice their faiths and engage in religious activities conveniently, fostering a harmonious and culturally rich environment.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Jumeirah Golf Estates

Residents of Jumeirah Golf Estates have access to a range of top-notch medical facilities nearby, ensuring comprehensive healthcare services. The Mediclinic Me'aisem, located in the nearby City Centre of Me'aisem, offers a variety of outpatient services, including general practice, pediatrics, and specialist consultations.

The NMC Royal Hospital in Dubai Investments Park provides advanced medical care with state-of-the-art facilities and a wide range of specialties. For urgent care and emergency services, the Saudi German Hospital in Al Barsha is within a short driving distance, renowned for its high-quality healthcare standards. These clinics and hospitals ensure that residents of Jumeirah Golf Estates have quick and easy access to essential medical services, promoting a healthy and secure living environment.

Jumeirah Golf Estates Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

The community is just 5 minutes from Dubai Sports City, which features numerous sporting venues and facilities. Residents can reach Dubai Investment Park within 5 minutes, providing access to a range of commercial and industrial businesses.

The bustling Expo City is only 8 minutes away, offering a hub of innovation and events. Al Maktoum International Airport is conveniently located 10 minutes from the estate, ensuring easy travel connectivity. Jebel Ali Port, a major shipping hub, is just 12 minutes away.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Jumeirah Golf Estates

data.answer:
In Jumeirah Golf Estates, residents can enjoy world-class golfing on championship courses, relax and socialize at the luxurious country club, and explore scenic walking and cycling trails amidst lush landscapes. Additionally, the community offers state-of-the-art fitness facilities and a variety of dining options for a well-rounded lifestyle.

Jumeirah Golf Estates Restaurants & Bars

The Crafty Fox Gastropub & Sports Bar in Jumeirah Golf Estates offers a vibrant atmosphere with a menu of classic pub fare and a wide selection of beverages. It's an ideal spot for sports enthusiasts to enjoy live games on big screens while savoring delicious food and drinks.

Bussola at Jumeirah Golf Estates offers an exquisite dining experience, combining authentic Italian cuisine with a sophisticated ambiance.

Beaches Near Jumeirah Golf Estates

Residents of Jumeirah Golf Estates have to drive about half an hour to reach the nearest beach. JBR Beach, located about 25 minutes away, offers a lively atmosphere with numerous dining and entertainment options. Kite Beach, approximately 30 minutes away, is popular for water sports and outdoor activities, featuring a scenic stretch of sand and various beachfront amenities.

Additionally, the serene Al Sufouh Beach, also known as the "Secret Beach," is around 25 minutes away and provides a quieter, more relaxed setting for beachgoers. These nearby beaches offer a perfect escape for residents seeking sun, sea, and leisure.

Hotels in Jumeirah Golf Estates

While Jumeirah Golf Estates primarily focuses on residential living, it offers luxurious accommodations within its community. The Jumeirah Golf Estates Hotel is an upscale option that provides guests with world-class amenities, stunning views of the golf courses, and exceptional service.

Additionally, nearby areas like Dubai Sports City and Motor City offer various hotel options, such as the Treppan Hotel & Suites by Fakhruddin and the Park Inn by Radisson, catering to both short-term visitors and long-term stays.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Jumeirah Golf Estates

One of the major landmarks in Jumeirah Golf Estates is the Jumeirah Golf Estates Clubhouse. The centerpiece of the community, it offers dining, recreational facilities, and social events with stunning views of the golf courses.

Approximately 18 minutes away, Dubai Marina offers luxury yachts, dining, shopping, and entertainment options. A multicultural festival park, Global Village is located about 20 minutes from Jumeirah Golf Estates. It showcases pavilions from various countries and offers shopping, dining, and live entertainment.

One of the things to consider about living in Jumeirah Golf Estates is its relatively higher cost of living. The luxurious properties and high-end amenities come with a premium price tag, which makes sense looking at the location and amenities.

What types of properties are available in Jumeirah Golf Estates?

Jumeirah Golf Estates offers a range of luxurious properties, including villas, townhouses, and apartments. These properties are designed with high-end finishes and are situated amidst beautifully landscaped gardens and world-class golf courses.

What amenities can residents enjoy in Jumeirah Golf Estates?

Residents have access to a wide array of amenities, including two championship golf courses, a country club, fitness centers, swimming pools, tennis courts, and a variety of dining and retail options. The community also features parks, walking trails, and children’s play areas.

Is Jumeirah Golf Estates a family-friendly community?

Yes, Jumeirah Golf Estates is highly family-friendly, offering a safe and secure environment with numerous recreational facilities for children and adults alike. There are also top-quality schools and nurseries in and around the community, making it an ideal place for families.

How accessible is Jumeirah Golf Estates from major areas in Dubai?

Jumeirah Golf Estates is conveniently located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, providing easy access to key areas in Dubai. It is just minutes away from Dubai Sports City, Dubai Investment Park, Expo City, and Al Maktoum International Airport, ensuring residents are well-connected to the rest of the city.

Who is the developer of Jumeirah Golf Estates?

The developer of the Jumeirah Golf Estates project is Jumeirah Golf Estates, owned by Istithmar, a Dubai World company.

How long is Jumeirah Golf Estates? 

Jumeirah Golf Estates spans over 1,119 hectares.

How do I get to Jumeirah Golf Estates? 

You can reach Jumeirah Golf Estates via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), Exit 27.

What are the advantages of living in Jumeirah Golf Estates? 

Living in Jumeirah Golf Estates offers luxury homes, world-class golf courses, scenic landscapes, high-end amenities, a strong sense of community, and excellent connectivity to key areas in Dubai.

data.content:
Jumeirah Golf Estates is a luxury residential area in Dubai, spanning over 1,100 hectares. The master-planned development offers a luxurious lifestyle and world-class amenities to its residents. It features two championship golf courses, Fire and Earth, designed by the legendary golfer Greg Norman.

The green community has tranquil parks, lakes, and nature strips. It comprises 16 distinct neighborhoods, each offering a unique blend of elegant villas, townhouses, and apartments. The facilities include a state-of-the-art clubhouse, fitness centers, swimming pools, tennis courts, and dining options.

Strategically located near major highways, Jumeirah Golf Estates provides easy access to Dubai's key destinations, including business districts, shopping malls, and airports.  It offers an active lifestyle to its residents, with plenty of parks and open spaces.

nodes.title: Ashwood Estates
nodes.about:
Ashwood Estates by Wasl Properties marks a prestigious addition to The Next Chapter in Jumeirah Golf Estates. Offering 4, 5 and 6-bedroom villas, the development combines refined design with modern comfort. Set amidst championship golf courses and world-class facilities, it creates an elevated lifestyle in a highly sought-after community.

This limited collection of freehold villas emphasizes privacy, elegance, and scale. With features such as private pools, lush gardens, and thoughtful layouts, Ashwood Estates caters to families seeking both grandeur and intimacy. Residents will enjoy exclusive community amenities while benefiting from a flexible 10% down payment plan designed to enhance long-term investment appeal.

nodes.title: Pinewood Village
nodes.about:
Pinewood Village by Wasl offers an exclusive collection of 3 and 4-bedroom villas and townhouses in The Next Chapter of Jumeirah Golf Estates. As part of one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities, it combines refined living with lush green surroundings and thoughtfully designed amenities.

Each villa features spacious layouts, skylit staircases, and outdoor seating areas tailored for modern family life. With just a 10% down payment and access to facilities such as a play zone, Pinewood Village presents a compelling investment opportunity with direct connectivity via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.

nodes.title: Jouri Hills
nodes.about:
Jouri Hills - a collection of luxury residences located in the luxury gated community of Jumeirah Golf Estates. The development offers 3-4 bedroom townhouses, five-bedroom villas, and six-bedroom mansions. The design is contemporary in style. The houses have spacious rooms. Each residence has a private garden, a terrace and a garage for 2 cars. Panoramic windows provide the houses with natural light, which creates an atmosphere of cosiness and harmony.

The complex adheres to the concept of eco-friendly, green plants are woven into the facades of the houses, and thanks to eco-friendly materials, environmental damage is minimised. Jouri Hills has modern amenities such as swimming pool, gymnasium, sports fields and children's play areas. The residences are located in the middle of a green park with many walking paths as well as recreational areas. Kindergartens, schools and medical centres are located nearby.

A major motorway, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, passes close to Jouri Hills, allowing residents to quickly reach key locations in Dubai. The famous Dubai Butterfly Garden and Dubai Miracle Garden parks, Global Village theme park, Palm Jumeirah, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are all within a 20-minute drive. Dubai Airport is a 35-minute drive away.

Jouri Hills is a community designed for living with children, providing opportunities for a prosperous family life. The complex is also an excellent investment opportunity, capable of generating a stable income of up to 6% per annum.

nodes.title: D-Villas
nodes.about:
D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates represents the latest luxury residential development by Dar Global, offering a premium collection of exclusive villas surrounded by breathtaking golf course views.

Designed for those seeking the pinnacle of refined living, D-Villas by Dar Global combine modern architecture with spacious layouts, set against the serene backdrop of two world-renowned championship golf courses. This unique development offers not just luxurious homes but an active and vibrant lifestyle within a prestigious community, complete with high-end retail, gourmet dining, and state-of-the-art wellness facilities.

nodes.title: Signature Mansions
nodes.about:
Signature Mansions is an exclusive new residential development by Signature Developers, offering luxury mansions in Jumeirah Golf Estates. This project features 18 luxurious villas with unique amenities such as The Lounge Spa and World of Wellness, geared towards families with children. Choose from 5 to 8 bedroom mansions, ideal for luxury living at Signature Mansions JGE. 

The development is divided into four exquisite collections: The Magnolia Collection with 8 mansions, The Orchid Collection with 5 mansions, The Jasmine Collection with 5 mansions, and The Rosa Collection which is the biggest and unique Signature Mansions. For those seeking Signature Mansions for sale, residents will enjoy breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline and the local golf course.

When everything comes together in harmony, we envision perfection. Signature Mansions redefine the unique fusion of community and privacy, encapsulated in a limited edition, clubhouse-style residential enclave. Discover Jumeirah Golf Estates luxury villas and Rosa Signature luxury homes Dubai at The Rosa Signature Mansions JGE.

nodes.title: Terra Golf Collection
nodes.about:
Discover Terra Golf Collection by Taraf, an esteemed residential community nestled in the highly sought-after Jumeirah Golf Estates. This elite neighborhood offers 6-bedroom standalone and twin villas, as well as 6-bedroom townhouses with spacious living spaces and captivating views of lush landscapes. 

Residents can luxuriate in private amenities like a gym, home cinema, private pool, and jacuzzi. Terra's villas and townhouses provide breathtaking, uninterrupted vistas of the lush golf course, all while embracing a design that's minimalist yet exudes elegance. The use of neutral color palettes and fundamental materials accentuates the inherent natural beauty, further enriched by luxurious finishes.

Terra, developed by Taraf, the real estate arm of YAS Holding, a prominent UAE-based investment holding company with a diverse business portfolio spanning various sectors and over 50 subsidiary companies. With 84 exquisite villas seamlessly integrated into the verdant landscapes of a prestigious golf course, Terra embodies contemporary design, functionality, and exclusivity. The architectural concept harmoniously blends modernist minimalism, sleek geometric lines, and the natural beauty of the golf course surroundings.
